reviewer_roles: Actual blind initial judgments saved separately before cross-review adjudication; all same underlying model.
disclosure: Roles are allocated to real executions. Two producer roles share one execution; no fictional identities. Same underlying model implies correlated-error risk.
role_capacity_note: Six genuinely spawned non-root executions are reused across waves due environment execution/thread limits. Research Architect later adjudicates without generating/reviewing samples. Production roles share one execution. Adversarial/diversity roles share one execution. No fictional 12-agent independence claim.
backup_execution_note: Backup manager authored/tested preflight/helper; /root executes exact inventory checkpoints and is recorded separately in receipts.
corrective_review_disclosure: Initial pilot/expansion judgments were blind and preserved. Subsequent metadata correction reviews were informed by prior issue topics and some aggregate counts, as disclosed in actual execution reports; agents independently recomputed facts/targets and did not read producer/reference or other verdict files. Corrective executions are not claimed fully blind.
source_recovery_review_disclosure: Expert current-provenance check read generator only after original blind review, captured all current causal candidates with filesystem writes denied, and checked own exact prior ACCEPT receipts. This was reproducibility verification, not a new blind semantic review.

memory_history_wave.expert_mode: V1 first blind; V2 corrective guided by own V1 criticism, initial V2 verdict before metadata encoding supplement
memory_history_wave.adversarial_mode: New V2 blind input-derived first predictions and judgments; public metadata encoding/code read after freeze, no other reviewer verdict read
memory_history_wave.adjudicator_mode: Prior public-design author, no producer/initial-review role; evidence joined after independent reviews
memory_history_wave.risk: Actual separate executions use same underlying model; correlated errors remain possible.

belief_evidence_wave.review_disclosure: Prospective expert supplied public previous-corpus diagnosis; no future target/verdict authored. Initial new-batch expert/red verdicts must be derived separately from inputs and frozen before access to other judgments. Design author may later adjudicate; producer/formal/root cannot approve. All actual agents share an underlying model, so correlated errors remain possible.
belief_evidence_wave.expert_first_mode: Input-only predictions frozen before canonical gold/property metadata. Own missing typed handler warnings preserved and resolved before first per-row judgments.
belief_evidence_wave.adversarial_first_mode: Input-only predictions then per-row judgments frozen; whole-batch token shortcut found afterward and final E/F REVISE judgments saved separately.
belief_evidence_wave.checker_correction_mode: Formal public-only correction with independent handmade fixtures; no producer/candidates/private reviews read.
belief_evidence_wave.capacity_events: Producer first resume and fresh-agent attempt failed thread limit; actual original producer successfully resumed after backup preparation completed. No fictitious replacement identity or approval.
